review.scope: Single-charge all-electric closed multi-axis rotational gel/fusion and water-tank cooling of a complete separately supplied unpainted, unrooted hollow PVC human-doll head component through first release.
review.source_and_method: Root read actual full Piper rotational/plastisol accounts, Joy separately sold vinyl-head and unpainted/unassembled/no-hair caveats, actual electric/heating alternatives and water-tank machine description, and electroformed mould context. These are a transparent technical synthesis, not one SKU/factory recipe. Equipment voltage/current/power/energy-label defects, generic dipping FAQs and multilayer painted patent alternatives are not adopted as parameters. Separate actual on-site formulation cannot be paper-outsourced; real ingredients, mixing, losses/utilities and complete upstream producer remain once. Complete EPA0010/3542A/8270E programme with incineration/GC-amenable/fraction/recovery limitations is bounded, not demonstrated qualification of a PVC outlet; 3C and Agilent Ar separation have source/matrix and sampling limits. No actual mist, additive, phthalate, HCl or absence is inferred from generic material. Actual unestablished essential method would block the affected concrete study; ordinary QA within established procedures is separately unperformed. No presently identified intrinsic unknown emitted species is asserted to be closed.
review.native_and_classification: Actual full state100 manufactured Parts and accessories of dolls family explicitly includes heads and excludes separate glass eyes; Product Mass/kg is genuine whole supplied component, not resin or whole doll. Narrower38530 head boundary is positively supported by full current UN/Adrie context. Native water secondary Volume0.001m3/kg is preserved as a compatibility restriction, not an independent density measurement or mass-balance filler. Pallet whole-name/wood board-slat route/lumber-mill gate and electrical taxonomy counterevidence are retained: use requires a real complete pallet and real transport/storage/provider bridge, no electricity or raw-board substitution. English fallback plus explicit absence-of-official-Chinese note is disclosure, not an invented native Chinese name.
review.event_stock_accounting: Complete original acceptance event/cohort fates, independent full wet stocks and gross legs versus attributable exchange/service vectors, own inherited history once, whole actual Qt and compatible nonoverlapping A/Q0 reviewed. No allocated physical receiver mass, extra component exports or duplicate providers.
review.bilingual: Scoped complete EN/ZH critical conditions and actual typed/literal/context/source/protocol/measurement/calculation/quality/inventory consistency reviewed; no scientific or empirical factory qualification.
review.remaining_limits: Actual measured configured quantities, real complete matched providers and source/matrix/dependency/site QA remain study obligations. Unestablished essential actual procedures stay holds; ordinary unresolved identities never become zeros/proxies.

pr34_repair.scope: Frontmatter/current review-state alignment verified against the retained independent review; unchanged methodology bodies and UUIDs.
